propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion verifier runs exhaust the bounded request budget without banking any criterion verdicts, producing CompletionRecoveryError instead of evidence-backed PASS/FAIL
Pydantic AI executes tool batches concurrently within a single model response, allowing deferred record calls that violate the incremental banking contract
Prompt-only instructions cannot enforce serialization of evidence collection and record calls across concurrent tool execution

A finite-state policy at the tool wrapper seam must atomically claim one governed action per response, count evidence steps for the live first-unbanked criterion, and invoke provisional met=false banking at response three if still unbanked
Simple control cases with fewer criteria successfully bank all verdicts, ruling out missing tool/schema wiring and confirming the defect is specific to dense criterion batching
